name: WPC Product QR Code for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Product QR Code is a powerful WooCommerce extension that dynamically generates customized QR codes for your e-commerce products. Simply install the plugin, and an elegant QR code icon will be automatically appended to your single product titles.

Customers can view and scan the QR code to instantly access the product via their mobile devices. Alternatively, store owners can use these QR codes in physical print media!

Live demo

Visit our live demo here to see how this plugin works.

Key Features

  • Customizable QR Modal: Add text above and below your QR codes and insert a custom logo seamlessly into the center of the QR canvas.
  • Live Preview: Make tweaks in the settings page and instantly preview exactly how your QR code will render – no page reloads required!
  • Dynamic Placeholders: Use {name} and {link} inside your top/bottom texts to automatically output the product’s title and its unique short link respectively.
  • Flexible Placements: Use the settings page to toggle the default QR icon position (before/after product title) or insert it freely anywhere in Elementor, Gutenberg, or widget areas using the [wpcqr] and [wpcqr_code] shortcodes.
  • Short URLs: Creates beautiful, shareable 4-character shortlinks (e.g., /qr/x1y2) that seamlessly 301 redirect to the actual product URL for optimal SEO and fast, dense QR codes.
  • Customizable Slug: Don’t like /qr/? Change it to /go/, /link/, or anything else right in the settings.
  • Comprehensive Statistics (Premium): Track how many times each QR code is scanned via a dedicated ‘QR Statistics’ page within WooCommerce. Includes total view counts, creation dates, ‘last accessed’ timestamps, and search filtering.
  • High Performance: Generates the QR code purely on the browser side (Canvas) via AJAX, removing render bloat from your server processor.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpc-product-qr-code directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WPClever -> Product QR Code to configure your short URL slug, QR texts, and upload a custom logo.
  4. Visit any single product page to test your new QR icon and view the popup.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WPC Product QR Code is an add-on for WooCommerce and requires the core WooCommerce plugin to be installed and activated.

Where does the QR icon appear?

The plugin allows you to choose exactly where the scalable SVG icon is placed: either directly before or exactly after the standard WooCommerce product title.

Can I place the QR Code anywhere else on the page?

Yes! We provide two convenient shortcodes that you can use in any custom builder, post, or text widget:
1. [wpcqr] – Appends the standard popup icon button.
2. [wpcqr_code] – Generates the full QR code design (image + text) directly onto the page, bypassing the popup modal completely.
Both shortcodes automatically detect the current product data. You can also manually specify a product by adding the product_id attribute (e.g., [wpcqr product_id="99"]).

Are the short URLs SEO friendly?

Yes! When scanned, the QR code resolves to the short URL which immediately performs a fast, server-side 301 Permanent Redirect to the canonical primary product URL.
